parsed.rationale: Four separate packages — Playlist, Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit — each declare an extension on URLSession in unrelated files (PlaylistFetcher.swift, URLSession+WebSession.swift, URLSessionProtocol.swift, RequestService.swift). The cluster signals a name-collision across these packages, meaning URLSession is being extended in multiple places with no shared ancestry or field overlap recorded. The Core package already contains a dedicated URLSession+WebSession.swift, which is the most semantically appropriate home for a consolidated URLSession extension; all three other packages already depend (directly or transitively) on Core given the typical layering of such a codebase. Consolidating into Core eliminates the risk of conflicting or redundant extension members and gives a single authoritative location for URLSession conformances and helpers.
